description: This PHP file contains functions for generating hardware system information in XML and HTML formats, including details about CPU, PCI, IDE, SCSI, and USB devices, utilizing external system info objects and generating XML/HTML output.

methods.name: xml_hardware
methods.description: Generates an XML string with hardware information including CPU, PCI, IDE, SCSI, and USB devices, using system info objects.

methods.name: html_hardware
methods.description: Generates an HTML table displaying hardware information, including CPU, PCI, IDE, SCSI, and USB devices, using XPath data.
